title.zh: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
title.en: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds

current_state.zh: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, an FDIC-insured tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY that users can convert one-for-one into SoFiUSD stablecoin for 24/7 crypto transactions and external transfers.
